metadata.description: Plugins that come with NewAl Code: one tap installs them, with nothing to download.

plugins.name: system
plugins.description: Your computer or phone, answered at once by a program (no model needed): /sysinfo (system, memory, storage, battery, the model sizes that fit), /disk (what takes the space), /clean (caches and old temporary files), /ports (what listens on which port), /programs (search, install, update with winget, pkg, Homebrew, apt), /serve (a folder's pages in the browser, --lan for the phone).

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: /csv <file> [column] [value column]: a CSV, TSV, Excel (.xlsx) or JSON file at a glance, computed by a program: rows, each column's type, empty cells, distinct values, minimum, maximum, mean, median and total, the most common values; with a column, a chart as an SVG file ("sales by region"). Arabic Windows files and Arabic digits included.

plugins.name: arabic
plugins.description: /rtl [file or folder] [--apply]: turns a site right-to-left for Arabic: dir="rtl" (and lang="ar") on the page, and CSS's left and right in their logical forms (margin-inline-start, text-align: start, float: inline-start, inset-inline, logical corner radii, 4-value margins split), in CSS files, <style> blocks, style attributes and JSX style objects. It lists the changes first; --apply writes them.

plugins.name: starters
plugins.description: /create <python|web|node|flask|fastapi> <name> [--ar]: a new project made by a program, not by the model: a Python package with a command line, an offline web page (a notes app), a Node module, a Flask site or a FastAPI service, each with its README, .gitignore and a test that it then runs. --ar: in Arabic, right-to-left.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Safety with full access: asks before an edit to secrets (.env, keys), before a force push, a hard reset, git clean, deleting a branch, dropping a database or publishing a package, and before a commit or push that would publish a token or private key. /secrets [--staged|--outgoing] finds leaked keys (GitHub, AWS, Google/Gemini, OpenAI/DeepSeek, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Slack, Stripe, Telegram, private keys).

plugins.name: format-on-edit
plugins.description: After each edit, formats the file with its project's formatter: gofmt, rustfmt and dart always; ruff or black, prettier and clang-format where the project is set up for them. Nothing happens where none is installed.
